category: Mental Health Crisis, Panic & Psychological First Aid
summary: Grounding and panic de-escalation protocols from SAMHSA, NAMI, and Mind
guidance:
If you or someone nearby is experiencing acute panic, hyperventilation, or extreme terror:
1. **The 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding Technique:** Name aloud:
• **5 things you can SEE** (e.g. wall clock, shoes, tree, doorknob, street lamp)
• **4 things you can physically FEEL** (e.g. feet on the floor, texture of clothing, cool phone case, chair back)
• **3 things you can HEAR** (e.g. distant cars, breathing, air conditioning)
• **2 things you can SMELL** (e.g. rain, coffee, clothing soap)
• **1 thing you can TASTE** (or say: *'I am safe right now in this exact moment'*)
2. **4-4-4-4 Box Breathing:**
• Inhale slowly through nose for **4 seconds**
• Hold breath gently for **4 seconds**
• Exhale smoothly through mouth for **4 seconds**
• Hold lungs empty for **4 seconds**
• Repeat 4 times to stimulate the parasympathetic nervous system and slow heart rate.
3. **Confidential Crisis Lines:** Text **HOME to 741741** (US/UK) or dial **14416** (Tele-MANAS India) / **988** (US).
